description.p: stlread reads binary or text STL files and returns a triangulation object.

fileformat is 'binary' or 'text'. For binary files, attributes is a uint16 column vector. For text files, attributes is an empty uint16 matrix with one row per triangle. solidID is a column vector identifying the solid group of each triangle.

example_item.example_item_description: Write and read a simple STL file.
